title: Lorentzian local-SUGRA WKB branch-supercharge kill test
registration_scope: This contract and its exact pass/fail matrix were frozen before the Phase 13A executable was created or run. The broad warning that local SUSY constraints need not define a nonzero physical global charge was already present in Phases 3 and 5, so this cycle is a preregistered source-scoped reproduction/bridge test and is not eligible for a novelty or confirmation claim.

target_claim.hypothesis: In a standard complex-linear local 4D N=1 supergravity route, the fermionic supersymmetry constraint descends to a nonzero physical odd operator Q that exchanges relational expanding and contracting WKB branch sectors, rather than merely acting within each branch or annihilating Dirac physical states.
target_claim.required_relation: P_minus Q_phys P_plus is nonzero and P_plus Q_phys P_minus is nonzero, while Q_phys flips fermion parity and its local-SUSY parent closes consistently on the Hamiltonian and gauge constraints.
assumptions: the comparison is made away from WKB turning points where the branch covector is nonzero
the local constraint is a complex-linear finite-order differential operator; CPT or complex conjugation is not renamed a fermionic supercharge
a local SUSY constraint and a nonzero reduced/asymptotic boundary charge are distinct objects
for the positive-constraint kernel gate, the physical space is ker C with C={Q,Q_dagger} on a positive finite Hilbert space
the source-scoped FRW principal symbol uses the matter-coupled 4D N=1 reduction of Moniz, arXiv:gr-qc/9606047, equations (9)-(11); this is not a claim that its ordering or inner product is unique
the modern closure control uses only the published scope of Eder-Sahlmann, arXiv:2010.15629: a pure, quasi-isotropic self-dual N=1 minisuperspace subclass, not the same chiral-clock model

acceptance: derive the leading WKB action of the source first-order FRW SUSY constraint on both exp(+i lambda S) and exp(-i lambda S)
verify exactly that each result retains its input phase and that the principal symbol is odd in fermion parity
verify that the branch off-diagonal blocks vanish while a generic branch-diagonal symbol remains nonzero
gates.falsifier_for_core: The local source symbol is branch diagonal, so it fails Q P_plus = P_minus Q for every nonzero generic symbol coefficient.

acceptance: construct a maximally favorable finite odd Q that flips both branch and fermion parity
verify Q^2=(Q_dagger)^2=0 and C={Q,Q_dagger} is positive
verify all four branch/parity cells of ker C are occupied
measure the induced physical cross-branch rank after projecting both input and output to ker C
gates.falsifier_for_core: The off-shell branch-flipping rank is nonzero but the induced physical rank is exactly zero because ker C is contained in ker Q intersect ker Q_dagger.

acceptance: verify a normalized two-mode CAR realization in which left/right odd constraints close on an even Hamiltonian symbol
keep this closure result logically independent from branch exchange
reject a semantic mutant that infers branch exchange from closure alone
gates.scope: This is a normalized principal-symbol control motivated by the published Eder-Sahlmann closure, not an executable reproduction of their full volume-difference operator.

acceptance: identify a gauge-independent relational branch projector and a common positive or conserved physical inner product
identify a nonzero reduced, residual, or boundary fermionic charge distinct from the local gauge constraint
verify the nonzero physical branch-exchange block on that common domain
gates.failure_policy: If the selected source supplies no adequate relational current/domain or no distinct physical charge, mark this gate INCONCLUSIVE/UNCONSTRUCTED; do not replace it with an internal sheet label.

supports_core_only_if: P13A_G4 is explicitly constructed rather than assumed
both physical cross-branch blocks are nonzero
the map is fermion odd and is not CPT, complex conjugation, flavor transport, or an appended sheet reflection
contradicts_under_frozen_assumptions_if: the local WKB source symbol is branch diagonal with zero cross blocks
or a branch-flipping local constraint becomes zero after projection to the positive Dirac physical kernel
inconclusive_if: a needed relational projector or common physical domain cannot be constructed in the selected source
or only a nonlocal/boundary charge outside the source model could evade the exact gates
frozen_decision.sequencing_rule: Phase 13B receives zero evidential weight for the literal branch=superpartner claim unless Phase 13A supports the core. If Phase 13A contradicts or remains unconstructed at the physical-domain gate, stop the core sequence; any spatial scattering calculation is a separately labeled auxiliary interface project.

semantic_mutants: fermion-odd but branch-diagonal local constraint reported as a branch exchanger
branch reflection tensored with a fermion-even identity reported as SUSY
off-shell branch-flipping rank reported without projection to the physical kernel
one-sided Q_dagger Q used instead of C={Q,Q_dagger} to evade the kernel theorem
whole-multiplet even flavor transport U reported as Q
anti-linear complex conjugation or CPT reported as a complex-linear fermionic supercharge
closure on the Hamiltonian constraint reported as proof of branch exchange

comparison_policy.matrix_equalities: exact entrywise equality and exact rank/nullspace
comparison_policy.null_model: not applicable; this is an exact deductive test

non_goals: claim a universal no-go for every boundary, asymptotic, nonlocal, or reduced supercharge
construct the full unreduced 4D quantum constraint algebra
claim that the old FRW ordering or inner product is unique
identify triad orientation, internal flavor, CPT branch, or fermion parity with the relational expansion branch
continue to Phase 13B as evidence for the core after a failed Phase 13A gate
ratify a scientific verdict, programme appraisal, Contract status, or canon change
